summary: F0–F5 completed and their implementation and evidence were archived before installing the declared-interface comparison. findings: The new study has four cases and sixteen randomized jobs, with development exposure declared and legal-reference independence false.
The current ledger remains 81/500; each job has at most 24 calls, for a 384-call reservation and absolute ceiling 465. No allowance is reset.
The largest method has eight bounded tasks. Generators return at most two readings and critics target at most four candidate IDs while retaining all source/context.
Paraphrase acceptance requires exact declared question and fact meanings plus matching Java/Python outcomes. Changed meanings, missing work and non-executable readings remain explicit.
Candidate-set coverage, extra alternatives, uncertainty, abstention and failed execution are reported together; no method ranking or production clearance follows.
